ck_day_plan_blocks_shape.name: ck_day_plan_blocks_shape
ck_day_plan_blocks_shape.value: ("day_plan_blocks"."kind" = 'task' AND "day_plan_blocks"."task_id" IS NOT NULL AND "day_plan_blocks"."name" IS NULL AND "day_plan_blocks"."list_id" IS NULL) OR ("day_plan_blocks"."kind" = 'break' AND "day_plan_blocks"."task_id" IS NULL AND "day_plan_blocks"."name" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("day_plan_blocks"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND "day_plan_blocks"."list_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_day_plan_blocks_minutes.name: ck_day_plan_blocks_minutes
ck_day_plan_blocks_minutes.value: ("day_plan_blocks"."kind" = 'task' AND "day_plan_blocks"."minutes" BETWEEN 5 AND 1440) OR ("day_plan_blocks"."kind" = 'break' AND "day_plan_blocks"."minutes" BETWEEN 5 AND 120)

ix_tasks_schedule_due.name: ix_tasks_schedule_due
ix_tasks_schedule_due.where: "tasks"."scheduled_on" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."schedule_applied_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."column" IN ('backlog', 'this_week')

ck_tasks_schedule_time_needs_day.name: ck_tasks_schedule_time_needs_day
ck_tasks_schedule_time_needs_day.value: "tasks"."scheduled_time" IS NULL OR "tasks"."scheduled_on" IS NOT NULL
